title: Tunisian Yellow Pea Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic stew originating from Tunisia, made with yellow peas, elegant spices, and a hint of tunisian flair.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the tunisian spice blend, cumin, and coriander. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the dried yellow peas, split red lentils, and vegetable broth.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 25-30 minutes, or until the peas and lentils are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
